title: The US House advances the Ratepayer Protection Act, aimed at preventing data center-related utility costs from being passed on to consumers, by a vote of 417-3 (Justin Papp/CNBC)
summary: Justin Papp / CNBC: The US House advances the Ratepayer Protection Act, aimed at preventing data center-related utility costs from being passed on to consumers, by a vote of 417-3 — The House on Wednesday advanced a bill by a vote of 417-3 that aims to curb data center-related utility bill rate hikes …
